Enum Class ItemCatalog

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ItemCatalog>
seng201.nunbutblood.models.ItemCatalog
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ItemCatalog>, Constable
public enum ItemCatalog extends Enum<ItemCatalog>
A central registry of all available items in the game. Use this enum to easily spawn predefined items.
